# Steps and paths that moved to the SAP-internal Piper library (sap-piper single binary).
# Pull requests touching any of these are no longer accepted in SAP/jenkins-library.
# Read by .github/workflows/inner-source-migration-check.yml from the base branch.
#
# Format, one entry per line, '#' starts a comment:
#   <stepName>    matches cmd/<stepName>[_generated][_test].go, resources/metadata/<stepName>.yaml,
#                 vars/<stepName>.groovy, test/groovy/<StepName>Test.groovy (case-insensitive),
#                 documentation/docs/steps/<stepName>.md
#   <path>        any entry containing '/' is matched as a literal path prefix
#                 (end directories with '/' to avoid matching pkg/build/ against pkg/buildpacks/)
